t: Sections 1 through 6, including the amendments made by such sections, shall take effect on the date that the Administrator of the Federal Aviation Administration notifies Congress that aviation operations in the airspace serving Love Field and the Dallas-Fort Worth area which are likely to be conducted after enactment of this Act can be accommodated in full compliance with Federal Aviation Administration safety standards in accordance with section 40101 of title 49, United States Code, and, based on current expectations, without adverse effect on use of airspace in such area.

fable.w: The tempting reading is that a formal notification conditioning the effective date is a participatory procedure. But the only actors are the FAA Administrator and Congress, both inside the federal government, so the notification never crosses the federal boundary. No state, local government, company, expert, or member of the public is consulted, heard, or given a right to sue.
fable.s: shall take effect on the date that the Administrator of the Federal Aviation Administration notifies Congress

qwen_block.w: The section requires the FAA Administrator to notify Congress when certain safety conditions are met. Congress is part of the federal government, so this notification is an internal government communication, not participation by outside parties. There is no requirement for consultation with the public, states, or other non-federal entities before the decision is made.
qwen_block.s: Sections 1 through 6, including the amendments made by such sections, shall take effect on the date that the Administrator of the Federal Aviation Administration notifies Congress that aviation operations in the airspace serving Love Field and the Dallas-Fort Worth area which are likely to be conducted after enactment of this Act can be accommodated in full compliance with Federal Aviation Administration safety standards in accordance with section 40101 of title 49, United States Code, and, based on current expectations, without adverse effect on use of airspace in such area.

opus.w: The only process here is the FAA Administrator notifying Congress, and both are part of the federal government. It might look like participation because it is a formal step that has to happen before the law takes effect. But nobody outside the federal government (such as states, local governments, airlines or the public) is consulted, invited to a hearing or given a right to object.
opus.s: shall take effect on the date that the Administrator of the Federal Aviation Administration notifies Congress

qwen_chat.w: The section requires the Administrator of the Federal Aviation Administration to notify Congress. According to the definition, Congress is inside the federal government, and notifications to Congress are explicitly excluded from the definition of participation. There is no requirement to consult or coordinate with any outside parties (such as the public, states, or private entities) before making the decision to notify Congress.
qwen_chat.s: Sections 1 through 6, including the amendments made by such sections, shall take effect on the date that the Administrator of the Federal Aviation Administration notifies Congress that aviation operations in the airspace serving Love Field and the Dallas-Fort Worth area which are likely to be conducted after enactment of this Act can be accommodated in full compliance with Federal Aviation Administration safety standards in accordance with section 40101 of title 49, United States Code, and, based on current expectations, without adverse effect on use of airspace in such area.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that notifying Congress is a form of participation because Congress is involved in the decision-making process. However, the definition explicitly states that Congress is INSIDE the federal government, and reports or notifications to Congress do not constitute participation. Furthermore, the notification is a unilateral act by the Administrator to trigger the effective date, not a consultation or coordination with an outside party.
